offering_description.value: XPO moves palletized freight for businesses in North America, combining shipments from multiple customers in shared trailers. Its European business provides dedicated trucking and other freight services through its own fleet and third-party carriers.

primary_services.value: Less-than-truckload freight; dedicated truckload transport; freight brokerage; managed transportation; multimodal freight transport

customer_segment.value: B2B: Manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, retailers and freight intermediaries

end_markets.value: Industrial manufacturing; retail and e-commerce; wholesale distribution; consumer goods; automotive

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Freight charges per shipment, plus charges for additional handling or delivery services; project or contract: Dedicated trucking capacity and managed transportation under customer contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Consolidates palletized freight through owned or leased terminals and fleets for commercial shippers; service provider: Arranges carrier capacity and manages freight movements for European shippers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and Mexico, plus European markets including France, the United Kingdom and Spain

specialization.value: related lines: Less-than-truckload, dedicated trucking, brokerage, managed transportation and multimodal freight

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving local and national commercial shipping accounts; online: Customer portals for freight quotes, shipment booking and tracking

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Interstate trucking requires FMCSA operating authority, and European road haulage requires operator licensing.

notes: The European operation is included based on my last known company structure, and its current ownership is uncertain.
